the clinical expression of asthma is dependent on the capacity to mount a specific IgG antibody response to HDM.
the presence of Hdm-specific IgG antibody in asthmatic children is not necessarily a result of the pathogenesis of asthma, but rather is a result of the etiological mechanism.
